description: Charts. Tables. Targets. One Connected View. Are your reports slowing down decisions because stakeholders cannot quickly compare trends, targets, totals, and supporting details in one view? ChartFusion is a certified Power BI custom visual that combines interactive charts and tabular analysis in one connected experience. Explore performance, compare targets, and review detailed values without switching between multiple visuals. Key Features Choose from line, lollipop, grouped column, stacked column, and combination charts. Add up to two optional in-visual filters using dropdowns, buttons, checkboxes, or timeline controls. Compare actual performance against configurable target lines, markers, labels, colors, and line styles. Display a synchronized data matrix with row totals, column totals, and additional measures. Apply conditional formatting to highlight KPIs, variances, percentages, and important business metrics. Customize colors, fonts, labels, markers, axes, gridlines, spacing, borders, and table layouts. Show or hide charts, filters, labels, totals, and table elements according to reporting needs. Use Power BI interactions including selections, cross-filtering, cross-highlighting, sorting, and tooltips. Why ChartFusion?
